column1: Otto Lopez stands out as the top pick, leading off at home with a strong track record of hitting safely in over 75% of his games and a clear platoon advantage against Sean Manaea. Zach Neto also offers reliability in the leadoff spot, showing a recent uptick in contact and drawing a favorable park boost in Boston. Jackson Chourio and Steven Kwan both benefit from platoon edges, but Lopez’s consistency and matchup make him the most dependable option tonight.
